verdict.rationale: Deepgram's own Voice Agent docs say a developer chooses which STT model transcribes the user, so the product directly offers STT model control. The evidence does not show transcription accuracy, choosing a third-party STT provider, or key-term boosting, so the story is only thinly covered. Missing for 10: key-term/keyword prompting controls, choice among STT providers, evidence of accurate real-time transcript output within the agent, independent corroboration of accuracy.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get accurate real-time transcription with control over the STT provider, language models, or key terms

citations.quote: A multilingual voice agent has two model decisions: which STT model transcribes the user, and which TTS model speaks the agent.
